items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: the very first person out of Duke's band that came with us had already left the band, and that was Juan Tizol.

ctx.x: first connected-- members of the Ellington organization, Johnny and Ben and --

Well, it was just because they knew what we were into, and they felt the band was trying something. And whether they agreed that what we were doing was the greatest or not, but they also knew that there was some bread to be gotten, plus the fact that they wouldn't be asked to do something that was foreign to their nature musically.
